tasks.title: Complete Database Schema Migration and Seeding
tasks.description: Finalize database schema migration, add missing governance tables, and create comprehensive seed data for production environment
tasks.details: Enhance existing Prisma schema with policy enforcement tables, compliance audit requirements, and advanced monitoring. Add Policy, ComplianceRule, SecurityEvent, and PerformanceMetric models. Create production-ready seed script with realistic test data including organizations, users, agents, and workflows. Run migrations safely with rollback procedures. Use Prisma 5.22.0 with PostgreSQL 15+ for ACID compliance and performance. Implement database connection pooling (PgBouncer) and read replicas for scaling.
tasks.testStrategy: Database migration tests, schema validation, seed data integrity checks, connection pool testing, and rollback procedure verification

tasks.title: Implement Production-Ready Authentication & Authorization
tasks.description: Enhance JWT authentication with refresh tokens, role-based access control, and enterprise SSO integration
tasks.details: Extend existing Fastify JWT implementation with secure refresh token rotation, rate limiting (Redis-backed), and multi-factor authentication. Implement RBAC with granular permissions using existing UserPermission model. Add SSO integration with SAML 2.0 and OAuth 2.0 providers (Auth0, Okta, Azure AD). Secure password hashing with bcrypt (cost factor 12), session management with secure HTTP-only cookies, and CSRF protection. Use @fastify/jwt 8.0.1 with RS256 algorithm and key rotation.
tasks.testStrategy: Authentication flow testing, JWT validation, refresh token rotation, RBAC permission checks, SSO integration tests, security vulnerability scanning

subtasks.title: Implement Secure JWT Authentication with Refresh Token System
subtasks.description: Extend Fastify JWT implementation with secure refresh token rotation, RS256 algorithm, and key rotation
subtasks.details: Upgrade @fastify/jwt to 8.0.1 and configure RS256 algorithm for JWT signing. Implement secure refresh token generation with rotation mechanism using cryptographically secure random tokens. Add JWT key rotation system with multiple valid keys for seamless transitions. Configure token expiration policies (15min access, 7day refresh) and implement automatic token refresh endpoints. Store refresh tokens securely in Redis with expiration tracking.

subtasks.title: Implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) System
subtasks.description: Build comprehensive RBAC system with granular permissions using existing UserPermission model
subtasks.details: Extend existing UserPermission model to support hierarchical roles and granular permissions. Create role management system with predefined roles (admin, user, viewer) and custom role creation. Implement permission inheritance and role composition. Add middleware for route-level permission checking and resource-based access control. Create permission caching mechanism using Redis for performance optimization.

subtasks.title: Implement Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
subtasks.description: Add MFA support with TOTP, SMS, and backup codes for enhanced security
subtasks.details: Implement Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP) using speakeasy library with QR code generation. Add SMS-based MFA using Twilio integration with rate limiting. Create backup recovery codes system with secure generation and single-use validation. Build MFA enrollment flow with step-by-step setup and recovery options. Add MFA bypass for emergency access with audit logging.

subtasks.title: Implement Enterprise SSO Integration
subtasks.description: Add SAML 2.0 and OAuth 2.0 integration with Auth0, Okta, and Azure AD providers
subtasks.details: Integrate SAML 2.0 authentication using passport-saml for enterprise SSO providers. Implement OAuth 2.0 flows for Auth0, Okta, and Azure AD using respective SDKs. Create provider configuration management with metadata import/export. Add user provisioning and deprovisioning workflows with attribute mapping. Implement SSO session management with cross-domain logout support.

subtasks.title: Implement Security Hardening and Session Management
subtasks.description: Add password hashing, secure session management, CSRF protection, and rate limiting
subtasks.details: Configure bcrypt with cost factor 12 for secure password hashing. Implement secure HTTP-only cookie sessions with SameSite and Secure flags. Add CSRF protection using @fastify/csrf-protection with token validation. Implement Redis-backed rate limiting for authentication endpoints with progressive delays. Add security headers middleware and password strength validation with complexity requirements.

subtasks.title: Implement Comprehensive Security Testing and Vulnerability Assessment
subtasks.description: Create comprehensive test suite for authentication security and vulnerability scanning
subtasks.details: Build comprehensive authentication test suite covering JWT validation, refresh token rotation, and MFA flows. Implement RBAC permission testing with edge cases and privilege escalation checks. Add SSO integration tests for all providers with mock SAML/OAuth responses. Create security vulnerability tests including brute force protection, session hijacking prevention, and token manipulation attempts. Integrate automated security scanning with OWASP ZAP and manual penetration testing procedures.

tasks.title: Develop Agent Registry and Discovery Service
tasks.description: Create centralized agent registry with capability management, health monitoring, and dynamic discovery
tasks.details: Build upon existing Agent model to create service registry with capability-based discovery. Implement agent health monitoring with heartbeat protocol, performance metrics collection, and auto-scaling based on workload. Use Redis for agent state caching and WebSocket connections for real-time status updates. Create agent lifecycle management (start, stop, restart, update) with Docker container orchestration. Implement load balancing algorithms (round-robin, least-connections, capability-based) for task distribution.
tasks.testStrategy: Agent registration/deregistration tests, health check monitoring, load balancing verification, failover testing, and performance benchmarking

subtasks.title: Implement Core Agent Registry Service with Capability Management
subtasks.description: Build the foundational agent registry service that handles agent registration, deregistration, and capability-based discovery using the existing Agent model
subtasks.details: Extend the existing Agent model in the database to include capability metadata, status tracking, and registration timestamps. Create REST API endpoints for agent registration/deregistration with validation and authentication. Implement capability-based discovery service that allows querying agents by their abilities (e.g., code analysis, deployment, testing). Add database indexes for efficient capability queries and agent lookups. Include agent metadata management for version tracking, deployment environment, and configuration settings.

subtasks.title: Develop Health Monitoring System with Heartbeat Protocol
subtasks.description: Create real-time health monitoring system that tracks agent status through heartbeat protocol and WebSocket connections
subtasks.details: Implement heartbeat protocol where agents send periodic health status updates to the registry. Create WebSocket server for real-time agent status communication and instant failure detection. Build health check endpoints that verify agent responsiveness and capability status. Add configurable health thresholds and timeout settings for different agent types. Implement automated unhealthy agent detection with graceful removal from active pool and notification system for admin alerts.

subtasks.title: Build Performance Metrics Collection and Redis Caching Layer
subtasks.description: Implement comprehensive performance monitoring with Redis-based caching for agent state and metrics
subtasks.details: Create metrics collection system that tracks agent performance indicators (response time, throughput, error rates, resource usage). Implement Redis caching layer for agent state, capability mappings, and performance metrics to reduce database load. Add metrics aggregation and historical data storage for trend analysis. Build real-time performance dashboard data feeds and alerting for performance degradation. Include cache invalidation strategies and data consistency mechanisms.

subtasks.title: Implement Load Balancing and Auto-Scaling Logic
subtasks.description: Create intelligent load balancing algorithms and auto-scaling system based on workload and performance metrics
subtasks.details: Implement multiple load balancing algorithms: round-robin for even distribution, least-connections for optimal utilization, and capability-based routing for specialized tasks. Create auto-scaling engine that monitors workload patterns and automatically adjusts agent pool size. Add workload prediction using historical data and machine learning models for proactive scaling. Implement scaling policies with cooldown periods, minimum/maximum instance limits, and cost optimization. Include performance-based routing that considers agent response times and success rates.

subtasks.title: Develop Agent Lifecycle Management with Docker Orchestration
subtasks.description: Build comprehensive agent lifecycle management system with Docker container orchestration for start, stop, restart, and update operations
subtasks.details: Create agent lifecycle management API that handles start, stop, restart, and update operations through Docker container orchestration. Implement rolling updates with zero-downtime deployments and automatic rollback on failure. Add agent configuration management with environment variable injection and secret handling. Build container health monitoring integration with Docker health checks and resource limit enforcement. Include agent version management, deployment history tracking, and batch operation support for multiple agents.

tasks.title: Build Workflow Engine with Deterministic Execution
tasks.description: Implement workflow orchestration engine with deterministic execution, dependency management, and audit trails
tasks.details: Enhance existing Workflow and WorkflowStep models with DAG-based execution engine using Bull Queue (Redis-backed) for task scheduling. Implement workflow state machines with idempotent operations, automatic retry mechanisms (exponential backoff), and comprehensive error handling. Add workflow versioning, A/B testing capabilities, and rollback procedures. Create visual workflow builder with drag-and-drop interface using React Flow. Include workflow templates for common patterns (CI/CD, code review, deployment).
tasks.testStrategy: Workflow execution tests, dependency resolution validation, retry mechanism testing, state persistence verification, and performance under load

subtasks.title: Design and Implement DAG-based Execution Engine Core
subtasks.description: Build the foundational DAG execution engine with topological sorting, dependency resolution, and parallel execution capabilities
subtasks.details: Implement directed acyclic graph (DAG) data structure for workflow representation with topological sorting algorithm for execution order. Create dependency resolution engine that validates workflow graphs and detects circular dependencies. Build parallel execution coordinator that can execute independent workflow steps concurrently while respecting dependencies. Integrate with Bull Queue for Redis-backed task scheduling and execution management.

subtasks.title: Implement Workflow State Machine with Idempotent Operations
subtasks.description: Create deterministic workflow state management system with idempotent operations and consistent state transitions
subtasks.details: Design workflow state machine with defined states (pending, running, completed, failed, paused, cancelled). Implement idempotent operations ensuring workflow steps can be safely retried without side effects. Create state persistence layer using PostgreSQL with optimistic locking to prevent race conditions. Add state transition validation and rollback capabilities for failed executions.

subtasks.title: Build Retry Mechanisms and Error Handling System
subtasks.description: Implement comprehensive error handling with exponential backoff retry logic and circuit breaker patterns
subtasks.details: Create retry mechanism with exponential backoff (base delay 1s, max delay 300s, max attempts 5). Implement circuit breaker pattern to prevent cascade failures. Add error classification system to determine retryable vs non-retryable errors. Create dead letter queue for permanently failed tasks and comprehensive error logging with context preservation.

subtasks.title: Implement Workflow Versioning and A/B Testing Framework
subtasks.description: Build workflow versioning system with A/B testing capabilities and safe rollback procedures
subtasks.details: Create workflow versioning system with semantic versioning (major.minor.patch). Implement A/B testing framework allowing traffic splitting between workflow versions. Add rollback mechanism to previous workflow versions with data migration support. Create deployment strategies (blue-green, canary) for workflow updates with automatic rollback on failure detection.

subtasks.title: Develop Visual Workflow Builder with React Flow
subtasks.description: Create drag-and-drop workflow builder interface using React Flow for visual workflow design and editing
subtasks.details: Build React Flow-based visual workflow editor with custom node types (task, decision, loop, parallel). Implement drag-and-drop functionality for workflow construction with real-time validation. Add property panels for configuring workflow steps, conditions, and parameters. Create workflow preview and simulation capabilities with step-by-step execution visualization.

subtasks.title: Create Workflow Template System and Library
subtasks.description: Build reusable workflow template system with pre-built templates for common automation patterns
subtasks.details: Create workflow template system with parameterization and customization capabilities. Build template library with common patterns: CI/CD pipelines, code review workflows, deployment processes, incident response, and data processing pipelines. Implement template versioning and sharing mechanisms. Add template marketplace with community contributions and rating system.

subtasks.title: Implement Comprehensive Testing Framework for Workflow Reliability
subtasks.description: Build extensive testing suite for workflow engine reliability, performance, and correctness validation
subtasks.details: Create unit tests for DAG execution engine, state machine transitions, and retry mechanisms. Implement integration tests for end-to-end workflow execution with real dependencies. Build performance tests for concurrent workflow execution and load testing with hundreds of parallel workflows. Add chaos engineering tests to validate error handling and recovery mechanisms under failure conditions.

tasks.title: Implement Policy Engine and Governance Controls
tasks.description: Create policy enforcement engine with business rules, compliance monitoring, and automated governance
tasks.details: Develop policy engine using rule-based system with JSON Schema validation and custom business logic. Implement policy types: access control, data retention, workflow approval, security scanning, and compliance requirements. Create policy editor with template library for common governance scenarios (SOX, GDPR, SOC 2). Add policy impact analysis, conflict detection, and automated remediation. Use Open Policy Agent (OPA) integration for complex policy decisions and audit trail generation.
tasks.testStrategy: Policy enforcement testing, compliance rule validation, conflict detection tests, remediation verification, and audit trail completeness

subtasks.title: Implement Rule-Based Policy Evaluation Engine
subtasks.description: Create core policy evaluation engine with JSON Schema validation and custom business logic processing
subtasks.details: Build the foundation policy evaluation engine using a rule-based approach with JSON Schema validation for policy structure. Implement custom business logic processor that can handle complex conditional statements, nested rules, and dynamic policy evaluation. Create policy execution context with request metadata, user context, and resource information. Add support for policy evaluation caching and performance optimization.

subtasks.title: Design Policy Definition and Schema Management System
subtasks.description: Create policy definition framework with schema management and template library for governance scenarios
subtasks.details: Design comprehensive policy definition schema supporting access control, data retention, workflow approval, security scanning, and compliance requirements. Create policy template library for common governance scenarios including SOX, GDPR, and SOC 2 compliance. Implement policy versioning, validation, and migration capabilities. Build policy editor interface with syntax highlighting and real-time validation.

subtasks.title: Build Compliance Monitoring and Reporting System
subtasks.description: Implement automated compliance monitoring with real-time tracking and comprehensive reporting capabilities
subtasks.details: Create compliance monitoring system that continuously tracks policy adherence across all system components. Implement real-time compliance scoring and violation detection with automated alerts. Build comprehensive reporting dashboard with compliance metrics, trend analysis, and audit-ready reports. Add support for multiple compliance frameworks and customizable reporting templates.

subtasks.title: Implement Policy Conflict Detection and Resolution
subtasks.description: Create intelligent conflict detection system with automated resolution and impact analysis capabilities
subtasks.details: Build policy conflict detection engine that identifies contradictory policies, overlapping rules, and potential enforcement issues. Implement intelligent conflict resolution using priority-based and rule-based resolution strategies. Create policy impact analysis tool that predicts effects of policy changes on existing workflows and user access. Add conflict visualization and recommendation system for policy administrators.

subtasks.title: Create Automated Remediation Workflows
subtasks.description: Build automated remediation system for policy violations with configurable response actions and escalation procedures
subtasks.details: Implement automated remediation workflows that can respond to policy violations with predefined actions such as access revocation, workflow blocking, or notification sending. Create configurable escalation procedures for different violation severities. Build remediation action library with common responses and custom action support. Add remediation audit trail and effectiveness tracking.

subtasks.title: Integrate Open Policy Agent (OPA) with Comprehensive Audit Trails
subtasks.description: Implement OPA integration for complex policy decisions with complete audit trail generation and decision logging
subtasks.details: Integrate Open Policy Agent (OPA) for handling complex policy decisions that require advanced rule evaluation capabilities. Implement OPA policy compilation and deployment pipeline. Create comprehensive audit trail system that logs all policy decisions, evaluation contexts, and decision rationale. Build audit query interface for compliance reporting and forensic analysis. Add decision replay and testing capabilities for policy validation.

tasks.title: Create Real-time Monitoring and Analytics Dashboard
tasks.description: Build comprehensive monitoring dashboard with real-time metrics, alerting, and performance analytics
tasks.details: Enhance existing monitoring service with real-time dashboard using React 18+ with TypeScript, Recharts for visualization, and WebSocket connections for live updates. Implement custom metrics collection (API response times, agent performance, workflow success rates, error rates) with Prometheus integration. Create alerting system with multiple channels (Slack, email, PagerDuty, webhooks) and escalation policies. Add performance analytics with trend analysis, capacity planning insights, and cost optimization recommendations.
tasks.testStrategy: Real-time data streaming tests, alerting system validation, dashboard responsiveness testing, metrics accuracy verification, and load testing

subtasks.title: Implement Real-time Metrics Collection and Aggregation Service
subtasks.description: Build metrics collection system with Prometheus integration for gathering API response times, agent performance, workflow success rates, and error rates
subtasks.details: Create metrics collection service that aggregates data from all system components. Implement custom metrics for API response times, agent performance indicators, workflow success/failure rates, and error tracking. Integrate with existing Prometheus infrastructure for metric storage and querying. Add metric filtering, aggregation rules, and data retention policies.

subtasks.title: Develop Real-time Dashboard Frontend with Live Data Visualization
subtasks.description: Create React 18+ TypeScript dashboard with Recharts for real-time data visualization and WebSocket connections
subtasks.details: Build responsive dashboard using React 18+ with TypeScript for type safety. Implement Recharts for data visualization including line charts, bar charts, and heat maps. Establish WebSocket connections for real-time data updates. Create dashboard layouts for different metric categories and user roles. Add interactive features like drill-down capabilities and time range selection.

subtasks.title: Build Multi-channel Alerting System with Escalation Policies
subtasks.description: Create comprehensive alerting system supporting Slack, email, PagerDuty, and webhook notifications with escalation rules
subtasks.details: Implement alerting engine with configurable thresholds and rules. Support multiple notification channels including Slack integration, email alerts, PagerDuty integration, and custom webhooks. Create escalation policies with time-based escalation and severity-based routing. Add alert suppression, acknowledgment system, and alert correlation to reduce noise.

subtasks.title: Implement Performance Analytics and Trend Analysis Engine
subtasks.description: Create analytics engine for trend analysis, capacity planning insights, and cost optimization recommendations
subtasks.details: Build analytics engine that processes historical metrics data to identify trends and patterns. Implement capacity planning algorithms that predict resource needs based on usage trends. Create cost optimization recommendations by analyzing resource utilization and performance metrics. Add anomaly detection for proactive issue identification and automated insights generation.

subtasks.title: Integrate Dashboard with Existing Infrastructure and Deploy
subtasks.description: Complete integration with existing Prometheus and WebSocket infrastructure and deploy monitoring dashboard
subtasks.details: Integrate all monitoring components with existing Prometheus setup and WebSocket infrastructure. Configure dashboard deployment with proper authentication and authorization. Set up monitoring for the monitoring system itself (meta-monitoring). Create user documentation and admin guides. Perform load testing and optimize performance for real-time data processing.

tasks.title: Enhance API Gateway with Advanced Routing and Security
tasks.description: Upgrade API gateway with intelligent routing, rate limiting, caching, and security features
tasks.details: Enhance existing Fastify gateway with advanced routing capabilities including path-based routing, header-based routing, and canary deployments. Implement sophisticated rate limiting with Redis backend, supporting per-user, per-endpoint, and global limits. Add response caching with cache invalidation strategies, request/response transformation, and circuit breaker patterns. Integrate security features: API key management, request validation with JSON Schema, response filtering, and WAF capabilities.
tasks.testStrategy: Gateway routing tests, rate limiting validation, cache performance testing, security feature verification, and failover scenario testing

subtasks.title: Implement Advanced Routing and Load Balancing
subtasks.description: Enhance Fastify gateway with intelligent routing capabilities including path-based routing, header-based routing, canary deployments, and load balancing strategies
subtasks.details: Extend existing gateway service with advanced routing logic supporting multiple routing strategies: path-based routing for service discovery, header-based routing for A/B testing, and weighted routing for canary deployments. Implement load balancing algorithms (round-robin, least connections, weighted) with health check integration. Add routing configuration management with dynamic route updates and service registry integration.

subtasks.title: Implement Sophisticated Rate Limiting with Redis Backend
subtasks.description: Build comprehensive rate limiting system supporting per-user, per-endpoint, and global limits with Redis-backed storage and sliding window algorithms
subtasks.details: Implement multi-tier rate limiting system using Redis for distributed rate limit storage. Support sliding window, token bucket, and fixed window algorithms. Create rate limit policies for different user tiers, API endpoints, and global system limits. Add rate limit bypass mechanisms for administrative users and monitoring systems. Implement rate limit headers and proper HTTP status codes for client feedback.

subtasks.title: Add Response Caching and Cache Invalidation Strategies
subtasks.description: Implement intelligent response caching with Redis backend, cache warming, invalidation strategies, and request/response transformation capabilities
subtasks.details: Build comprehensive caching layer with Redis backend supporting multiple cache strategies: time-based expiration, tag-based invalidation, and content-aware caching. Implement cache warming for frequently accessed endpoints, response transformation pipelines, and cache bypass mechanisms. Add cache hit/miss metrics and cache performance monitoring with automatic cache optimization based on usage patterns.

subtasks.title: Integrate Security Features and WAF Capabilities
subtasks.description: Implement comprehensive security features including API key management, request validation, response filtering, and Web Application Firewall capabilities
subtasks.details: Build security middleware layer with API key management system, JSON Schema request validation, and response filtering capabilities. Implement WAF functionality with OWASP Top 10 protection, SQL injection prevention, XSS filtering, and malicious payload detection. Add IP whitelisting/blacklisting, geographic restrictions, and bot detection mechanisms. Integrate with existing authentication system for unified security policies.

subtasks.title: Implement Circuit Breaker Patterns and Failover Mechanisms
subtasks.description: Add circuit breaker patterns, health monitoring, and automated failover mechanisms to ensure high availability and graceful degradation
subtasks.details: Implement circuit breaker patterns for upstream services with configurable failure thresholds and recovery strategies. Add comprehensive health monitoring for all gateway components and downstream services. Create automated failover mechanisms with backup service routing and graceful degradation modes. Implement retry policies with exponential backoff and jitter. Add real-time monitoring dashboards and alerting for circuit breaker state changes.

tasks.title: Develop GitHub and External Integration Layer
tasks.description: Create seamless integration with GitHub, Slack, and other external services with webhook support
tasks.details: Extend existing Integration model with GitHub App integration for repository access, PR management, and issue tracking. Implement Slack bot with interactive components for workflow approvals and notifications. Create webhook processing system with signature verification, retry logic, and rate limiting. Add integration marketplace with pre-built connectors for common tools (Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, GitLab). Use Octokit SDK for GitHub API interactions and Slack Bolt SDK for Slack integrations.
tasks.testStrategy: GitHub integration tests, Slack bot interaction testing, webhook processing validation, external API reliability testing, and security verification

subtasks.title: Implement GitHub App Integration with Repository Management
subtasks.description: Create GitHub App with repository access, PR management, issue tracking, and webhook handling using Octokit SDK
subtasks.details: Develop GitHub App registration and authentication flow with repository permissions. Implement repository access management, pull request operations (create, review, merge), issue tracking integration, and branch protection rules. Set up webhook endpoints for repository events (push, PR, issues) with signature verification. Use Octokit SDK for all GitHub API interactions and implement rate limiting compliance.

subtasks.title: Develop Slack Bot with Interactive Components
subtasks.description: Build Slack bot using Bolt SDK with interactive components for workflow approvals and notifications
subtasks.details: Create Slack bot application with OAuth 2.0 authentication and workspace installation flow. Implement interactive components including buttons, modals, and select menus for workflow approvals. Build notification system for agent status updates, workflow completions, and alert management. Add slash commands for common operations and user mentions for direct interactions. Use Slack Bolt SDK with proper event handling and error management.

subtasks.title: Create Webhook Processing System with Security and Reliability
subtasks.description: Build robust webhook processing infrastructure with signature verification, retry logic, and rate limiting
subtasks.details: Implement webhook endpoint infrastructure with signature verification for security. Create retry mechanism with exponential backoff for failed webhook deliveries. Add rate limiting per integration source and implement webhook queue processing with Redis. Build webhook transformation layer to normalize different payload formats and add comprehensive logging and monitoring for webhook processing pipeline.

subtasks.title: Build Integration Marketplace with Pre-built Connectors
subtasks.description: Develop integration marketplace with connectors for Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, GitLab and other external tools
subtasks.details: Create integration marketplace framework with plugin architecture for external tool connectors. Implement pre-built integrations for Jira (issue sync), Confluence (documentation), Jenkins (CI/CD), and GitLab (repository management). Build integration configuration UI with credential management and connection testing. Add integration discovery, installation, and lifecycle management features with marketplace catalog and rating system.

tasks.title: Implement Comprehensive Security and Compliance Framework
tasks.description: Build enterprise-grade security framework with threat detection, vulnerability scanning, and compliance reporting
tasks.details: Enhance existing security service with automated vulnerability scanning using Snyk API integration, secret detection with TruffleHog, and SAST/DAST scanning integration. Implement zero-trust security model with end-to-end encryption, secure secret management using HashiCorp Vault, and comprehensive audit logging. Add compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) with automated reporting and evidence collection. Create threat detection using ML-based anomaly detection and behavioral analysis.
tasks.testStrategy: Security scanning validation, vulnerability detection accuracy, compliance reporting verification, threat detection testing, and penetration testing

subtasks.title: Implement Automated Vulnerability Scanning Pipeline
subtasks.description: Set up comprehensive vulnerability scanning using Snyk API, TruffleHog for secret detection, and SAST/DAST integration
subtasks.details: Integrate Snyk API for dependency vulnerability scanning, implement TruffleHog for secret detection in code repositories, set up SAST scanning with SonarQube or similar tools, configure DAST scanning for running applications, create automated pipeline integration with CI/CD, and establish vulnerability reporting and remediation workflows.

subtasks.title: Implement Zero-Trust Security Model with End-to-End Encryption
subtasks.description: Build zero-trust architecture with comprehensive encryption, network segmentation, and identity verification
subtasks.details: Implement end-to-end encryption for all data in transit and at rest, create network micro-segmentation with granular access controls, establish continuous identity verification and device trust validation, implement least-privilege access principles, and create secure communication channels between all services.

subtasks.title: Deploy HashiCorp Vault for Secure Secret Management
subtasks.description: Set up HashiCorp Vault for centralized secret management with automatic rotation and secure access
subtasks.details: Deploy HashiCorp Vault cluster with high availability configuration, implement secret engines for different credential types, create automated secret rotation policies, establish secure authentication methods for services, implement encryption as a service, and create backup and disaster recovery procedures.

subtasks.title: Build Comprehensive Audit Logging System
subtasks.description: Create enterprise-grade audit logging with tamper-proof storage and real-time monitoring
subtasks.details: Implement comprehensive audit logging for all system activities, create tamper-proof log storage with cryptographic signatures, establish real-time log monitoring and alerting, implement log retention policies and compliance requirements, create searchable log analytics platform, and establish incident response integration.

subtasks.title: Implement ML-Based Threat Detection and Behavioral Analysis
subtasks.description: Deploy machine learning models for anomaly detection and behavioral analysis to identify security threats
subtasks.details: Develop ML models for user behavior analysis and anomaly detection, implement real-time threat scoring and risk assessment, create behavioral baselines for normal system operations, establish automated threat response and containment procedures, integrate with security information and event management (SIEM) systems, and create threat intelligence feeds integration.

subtasks.title: Build Automated Compliance Framework for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR
subtasks.description: Create automated compliance monitoring and reporting for multiple regulatory frameworks
subtasks.details: Implement automated compliance monitoring for SOC 2 Type II requirements, create ISO 27001 control implementation and evidence collection, establish GDPR compliance automation with data mapping and consent management, create automated compliance reporting and dashboard, implement evidence collection and audit trail generation, and establish compliance violation detection and remediation.

subtasks.title: Implement Security Testing and Validation Framework
subtasks.description: Create comprehensive security testing procedures including penetration testing and vulnerability validation
subtasks.details: Establish automated penetration testing procedures and schedules, create security test suites for vulnerability validation, implement red team/blue team exercises, create security metrics and KPI tracking, establish continuous security assessment procedures, implement security regression testing, and create security incident simulation and response testing.

tasks.title: Optimize Performance and Implement Auto-scaling
tasks.description: Implement performance optimization, caching strategies, and horizontal auto-scaling capabilities
tasks.details: Implement comprehensive caching strategy with Redis for session storage, query result caching, and application-level caching. Add database query optimization with connection pooling, read replicas, and query performance monitoring. Create auto-scaling logic based on CPU, memory, and custom metrics using Docker Swarm or Kubernetes HPA. Implement CDN integration for static assets, response compression, and optimized API endpoints. Add performance profiling with APM tools (New Relic, DataDog) integration.
tasks.testStrategy: Performance benchmarking, auto-scaling behavior testing, cache efficiency validation, database performance testing, and load testing with realistic traffic patterns

subtasks.title: Implement Comprehensive Redis Caching Strategy
subtasks.description: Set up Redis for session storage, query result caching, and application-level caching with cache invalidation strategies
subtasks.details: Configure Redis cluster for high availability, implement session storage with secure serialization, create query result caching with TTL management, add application-level caching for frequently accessed data, and implement cache invalidation patterns (write-through, write-behind, cache-aside). Include Redis monitoring and performance metrics.

subtasks.title: Optimize Database Performance with Connection Pooling and Read Replicas
subtasks.description: Implement database optimization strategies including connection pooling, read replicas, and query performance monitoring
subtasks.details: Configure Prisma connection pooling with optimal pool sizes, set up PostgreSQL read replicas for read-heavy operations, implement query performance monitoring with slow query detection, add database connection health checks, and create query optimization analysis tools with execution plan monitoring.

subtasks.title: Create Auto-scaling Logic with Custom Metrics
subtasks.description: Implement horizontal auto-scaling based on CPU, memory, and custom application metrics using container orchestration
subtasks.details: Design auto-scaling algorithms based on CPU utilization, memory usage, request queue length, and response times. Implement Docker Swarm or Kubernetes HPA integration with custom metrics collection, scaling policies with cooldown periods, and service discovery updates during scaling events.

subtasks.title: Integrate CDN and Response Optimization
subtasks.description: Implement CDN integration for static assets, response compression, and API endpoint optimization
subtasks.details: Configure CDN for static asset delivery with proper cache headers, implement gzip/brotli compression for API responses, optimize API endpoints with response size reduction, add asset minification and bundling, and implement edge caching strategies with cache purging mechanisms.

subtasks.title: Set up APM Integration and Performance Profiling
subtasks.description: Integrate Application Performance Monitoring tools with comprehensive performance profiling and alerting
subtasks.details: Integrate APM tools (New Relic, DataDog) with custom instrumentation, implement performance profiling for CPU, memory, and I/O operations, create performance dashboards with SLA monitoring, set up alerting for performance degradation, and add distributed tracing for request flow analysis.

tasks.title: Create Testing and Quality Assurance Framework
tasks.description: Build comprehensive testing framework with automated testing, quality gates, and continuous validation
tasks.details: Enhance existing testing service with comprehensive test suite including unit tests (Vitest), integration tests (Supertest), E2E tests (Playwright), and API contract testing (Pact). Implement quality gates with code coverage requirements (>80%), security scanning, performance benchmarks, and compliance checks. Add automated testing pipelines with parallel execution, test result reporting, and failure analysis. Create test data management with realistic datasets and data masking for sensitive information.
tasks.testStrategy: Test coverage validation, quality gate enforcement, automated pipeline testing, test data integrity verification, and testing framework performance

subtasks.title: Implement Comprehensive Test Suite Framework
subtasks.description: Set up multi-layered testing framework with unit, integration, E2E, and API contract testing using Vitest, Supertest, Playwright, and Pact
subtasks.details: Configure Vitest for unit testing with TypeScript support and coverage reporting. Set up Supertest for API integration testing with request/response validation. Implement Playwright for E2E testing with cross-browser support and visual regression testing. Add Pact for API contract testing between services. Create test utilities, mocks, and fixtures for consistent testing patterns across all test types.

subtasks.title: Create Quality Gates and Coverage Requirements
subtasks.description: Implement quality gates with code coverage thresholds, security scanning, performance benchmarks, and compliance checks
subtasks.details: Set up code coverage reporting with >80% threshold enforcement using Istanbul/c8. Integrate security scanning tools (Snyk, ESLint security rules) into quality gates. Implement performance benchmarks for API response times and memory usage. Create compliance checks for code standards, documentation requirements, and security policies. tasks.title: Build Comprehensive Blockchain Integration for AI Agent Platform
tasks.description: Develop a complete Web3 ecosystem with smart contracts, NFT marketplace, DeFi features, wallet integration, IPFS storage, and DAO governance for the AI agent platform.
tasks.details: Build upon the existing blockchain package foundation to create a comprehensive Web3 ecosystem for the Urnlabs AI Agent Platform. Extend the current AgentNFT, UrnToken, and AgentMarketplace smart contracts with additional DeFi functionality including yield farming, liquidity pools, and staking rewards. Implement comprehensive Web3 wallet integration supporting MetaMask, WalletConnect, and native mobile wallets using the existing @metamask/sdk and @walletconnect/client dependencies. Create a decentralized storage layer using IPFS via the existing ipfs-http-client and pinata-sdk for agent metadata, workflow data, and governance documents. Develop DAO governance system with proposal creation, voting mechanisms, and treasury management integrated with the existing UrnToken staking system. Add DeFi yield farming contracts that allow users to stake LP tokens and earn URN rewards, automated market maker (AMM) integration with Uniswap V3 using existing @uniswap dependencies, and Chainlink price oracle integration for accurate token pricing. Implement cross-chain bridge functionality for multi-network deployment (Ethereum, Polygon, BSC) with automated asset bridging and liquidity management. Create Web3 middleware for existing API endpoints to support blockchain transactions, smart contract interactions, and gas optimization. Add NFT metadata enhancement with dynamic traits based on agent performance metrics stored on-chain. Implement security features including multi-signature wallets for treasury management, timelock contracts for governance changes, and emergency pause mechanisms. Integrate with existing security and monitoring services for blockchain transaction monitoring, smart contract vulnerability scanning, and gas price optimization. Create comprehensive SDK extensions for mobile platforms to support Web3 functionality in React Native, Flutter, and native iOS/Android applications.
tasks.testStrategy: Comprehensive smart contract testing using Hardhat test suite with >95% code coverage, including unit tests for all contract functions, integration tests for cross-contract interactions, and property-based testing for DeFi mechanisms. Deploy contracts to test networks (Sepolia, Mumbai) for integration testing with frontend applications. Implement automated security testing using tools like Mythril, Slither, and Securify for vulnerability detection. Create end-to-end tests for wallet integration flows including connection, transaction signing, and error handling across different wallet providers. Test IPFS storage reliability with load testing for metadata uploads, retrieval speed benchmarks, and content addressing verification. Validate DAO governance workflows with proposal lifecycle testing, vote counting accuracy, and treasury management functionality. Perform DeFi protocol testing including yield farming calculations, liquidity pool mechanics, and price oracle accuracy. Conduct cross-chain bridge testing with asset transfer verification, bridge security validation, and failover mechanism testing. Test mobile SDK blockchain integration with device-specific wallet interactions and transaction signing flows. Implement gas optimization testing to ensure transaction costs remain within acceptable limits. Create performance benchmarks for blockchain API response times and smart contract execution costs.
